text: Company filings data for 7,600+ listed companies in Korea, Japan, Taiwan and the UAE, in English and in one schema. Korea: annual financials, valuation ratios, 21,785 5%+ ownership filings, 5,084 convertible bond filings and a workforce panel. Japan, Taiwan, UAE: latest filed accounts. Plus Korea trade by partner country. Delivered by API, CSV, Parquet and MCP, each with a data dictionary, coverage table and free sample. Public prices from 29 USD.

Collected directly from primary public sources: DART (Korea FSS), EDINET (Japan FSA), the TWSE OpenAPI (Taiwan), ADX and DFM disclosures (UAE) and Korea Customs statistics. Figures are kept as filed, never restated or estimated. A value we could not obtain is null, not zero, and every dataset states its coverage. Each record carries its source and build date. No report text, PDFs or consumer personal data are collected.
